subject: Reopen quiet window — fit feedback and next step?
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@clearskyanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + next step (ClearSky discovery)

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for taking time earlier today. Short recap from my side and two suggested next steps so we can keep momentum without a big lift on your end.

Recap (5 bullets):
- You’re evaluating LLM inference to power query summarization for analyst workflows (internal product).
- Primary constraints: predictable latency at <120ms p95 for short prompts, and strict data retention rules for PII across EU/US teams.
- Success criteria: pilot with 2 workloads inside 8 weeks, clear cost-per-query target, and sign-off from security.
- Important integrations: AWS VPC peering + existing SSO (Okta).
- Risk areas: procurement timeline and legal review for data retention.

Attachments: Discovery-Notes-ClearSky.pdf (short summary + screenshots), Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx (proposed milestones).

Two asks:
1) Quick fit signal — on a scale of 1–5, how aligned is Redwood to your needs today? A one-line reply is perfect.
2) If that’s a 3–5, would you be open to a 20-minute micro-demo next week to validate latency & cost assumptions? I can share a time-slot link if so.

If now isn’t the right moment, tell me the best time to reopen (quiet window) and I’ll follow up then — I don’t want to clutter your inbox.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0142

> — Oliver
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@clearskyanalytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Quick recap + next step (ClearSky discovery)

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the recap and materials. I’ve passed both docs to our infra lead and legal; they’ll take a look this week. Will aim to give you a fit signal by EOD Friday.

Oliver

On Wed, Dec 8, 2027 at 2:22 PM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> (See attached recap and MAP)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@clearskyanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Reopen quiet window — fit feedback and micro-commit?

Hi Oliver —

Wanted to reopen the quiet window since I haven’t seen a fit signal. Completely understand how these reviews slip into a backlog. Two quick options that would help us and keep things low-effort for you:

A) One-line fit signal (1–5) and we’ll pause outreach until your reopen date.
B) 20-minute micro-demo this week to validate the latency/cost assumptions (I’ll show a short run against an anonymized sample).

If neither works, could you share who on your side is best to own the pilot conversation (name + email) and the best date to check back?

We’re flexible on timing — I don’t want to push prematurely but would hate to lose what looked like a clear opportunity to move quickly here. Ben (cc) can jump in on procurement/pricing questions if helpful.

Appreciate any signal — even “not now”.

Thanks,
Soojin

Hey Oliver —

Aditya here from Soojin’s team. Just checking in on behalf of Soojin — any update after your legal/infra review? If helpful, we can do a 15-minute sync today to answer any procurement questions.

Link to quick calendar: https://cal.com/redwood/15m (or reply with a time).

If you prefer, reply with a simple: 1) Not a fit, 2) Need more time (tell us when), or 3) Ready for 15m.
